name: citlyze
description: Ask your AI search visibility data anything: prompts, citations, competitors, and recommendations from Citlyze.
long_description:
Citlyze tracks how your brand shows up in AI search engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your Citlyze workspace so you can explore visibility scores, tracked prompts, cited domains, competitor comparisons, optimization recommendations, and AI crawler activity in plain language.

All tools are read-only: nothing in your workspace can be modified through this extension. You need a Citlyze account with API access and a workspace API key, created at https://app.citlyze.com/workspace-settings.

tools.name: get_workspace_overview
tools.description: Workspace name, target brand, active prompt/location/engine counts, competitors, and the latest completed measurement window.

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: List tracked prompts with text, intent, tier, and active state.

tools.name: list_measurement_windows
tools.description: List measurement windows (tracking snapshots), newest first.

tools.name: get_visibility_overview
tools.description: Headline AI visibility metrics per brand and engine for a measurement window.

tools.name: get_prompt_visibility
tools.description: Per-engine and per-location visibility metrics for a single tracked prompt.

tools.name: list_citations
tools.description: Domains cited in AI answers, grouped with citation counts and sample URLs.

tools.name: list_recommendations
tools.description: AI visibility optimization recommendations, highest priority first.

tools.name: list_competitor_visibility
tools.description: Compare AI visibility across the target brand and tracked competitors.

tools.name: list_crawler_events
tools.description: Daily AI crawler visits (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bingbot, and more) on tracked sites.

api_key.title: Citlyze API key
api_key.description: Workspace API key from https://app.citlyze.com/workspace-settings (starts with aeo_live_). Requires a plan with API access.
